# Project tools

7 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `get_project_info`

Get basic project information: name, version, Godot version, path, main scene

Takes no parameters.

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/01-project.json`, test P-01:

```json
{}
```

## `list_project_files`

List files in the project (optionally filtered by folder path or file extension)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `path` | `string` | — | Folder path to list (default: res://) |
| `filter` | `string` | — | File extension filter, e.g. '.gd' or '.tscn' |
| `max_results` | `integer` | — | Maximum files to return (default 500, negative for no limit). The response carries truncated: true when the listing stopped early. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/01-project.json`, test P-03:

```json
{
  "path": "res://"
}
```

## `search_files`

Search for files by name or text content

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `query` | `string` | yes | Search query string |
| `type` | `string` | — | Search by filename (default) or file content One of: `"name"`, `"content"`. |
| `max_results` | `integer` | — | Maximum matches to return (default 500, negative for no limit). The response carries truncated: true when the search stopped early. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/01-project.json`, test P-05:

```json
{
  "query": "plugin",
  "type": "name"
}
```

## `get_project_settings`

Get one or all project settings. Pass setting_path for a specific setting (e.g. 'physics/2d/default_gravity'), omit for common defaults

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `setting_path` | `string` | — | Specific setting path, e.g. 'physics/2d/default_gravity' |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/01-project.json`, test P-06:

```json
{}
```

## `set_project_setting`

Set a project setting and save project.godot

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `setting_path` | `string` | yes | Setting path, e.g. 'application/config/name' |
| `value` | any | yes | New value (string, number, bool, or array) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/01-project.json`, test P-07:

```json
{
  "setting_path": "application/config/description",
  "value": "MCP Test Project"
}
```

## `convert_uid`

Convert between Godot UID (uid://...) and resource path (res://...)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `uid` | `string` | — | Resource UID, e.g. 'uid://abc123' |
| `path` | `string` | — | Resource path, e.g. 'res://scenes/Player.tscn' |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/01-project.json`, test P-09:

```json
{
  "uid": "uid://invalid_test_uid_xyz"
}
```
